result.brief: 提出协同世界模型，将人-机器人观测解耦为共享物体关系状态与具身特定上下文，并用效应交换与动作敏感性目标对齐跨具身潜动作，实现单次人类演示的零样本技能迁移。
result.reason: Learns shared latent dynamics world model across human and robot embodiments, with latent action alignment and disentangled object-relation state; core contribution is representation/world modeling.
